deployments_detail.use: Digital Train Inspection (DTI) Portals: trackside machine-vision portals with 24MP cameras and stadium lighting capture ~1,000 360-degree images per railcar at up to 70 mph; 75+ in-house deep-learning algorithms autonomously flag mechanical defects (cracked wheels, missing/broken components) and auto-generate work orders. Deployed at multiple locations across the 22-state network. [Norfolk Southern in-house Data Science/AI team; Georgia Tech Research Institute (partner)]
deployments_detail.value: 25,000+ mechanical defects identified in 2023; 85 Tier 1 critical defects detected; first-ever autonomous cracked-wheel detection in North American rail
